title: VERLONIQ Lead Assistant — enquiry input (webhook request body)
description: What a trusted backend (never a browser) POSTs to the n8n webhook. The request must also carry the shared secret header configured on the Webhook node.

business_id.description: Must be a key of `businesses` in the Workflow Configuration node (code/00-config.js). The template ships with fictional demo profiles: electrical, plumbing, aircon, security, cleaning.

submission_id.description: Optional unique id from the calling system. A retry with the same id is treated as a duplicate, so retries never create a second lead.

examples.enquiry_text: Hi, it's Mia Thompson. Our power keeps tripping and there's a burning smell coming from the switchboard at our house in Chermside. Call me on 0412 555 018.
